ai.title: Fireworks fallback to standard API on any 500 error
ai.summary: Fireworks custom deployment fallback logic updated to trigger on any 5xx status code, replacing the previous 503-only check. This ensures transient server errors (500, 502, 504) also fall through to the standard API, improving reliability. The `DEPLOYMENT_SCALING_UP` specific handling remains but is now nested within the broader 5xx condition. Affects `web/src/llm-api/fireworks.ts`.

eli5.text: When you ask the service for a response from a specialized version of a model, that version occasionally fails with transient server errors that previously weren't retried properly. Now, any server-side error (such as timeout, gateway, or internal errors), not just one specific kind, will cause the request to automatically retry using the more reliable standard path. This applies internally and improves reliability for users interacting with specialized model deployments. The change is live today.
